capabilities: Chat with OpenAI, Anthropic or local OpenAI-compatible models in one panel
Answer questions with RAG over indexed notes and canvases, listing source fragments
Edit notes and canvases through model-proposed diffs that require approval
Save conversation history and group chats into projects with per-project system prompts
Run chats in Fast/Normal/Think and Chat/Learn/Code modes with optional provider-side web search
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.7.2+); free and open source under MIT; full privacy documentation in PRIVACY.md; manifest flags it as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with AI models using your own notes as context or to let a model propose changes to notes.
